label: atlantis_talk_01_botan_01
text: So this is the inside of the Great Crater of\nPaldea—Area Zero...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_botan_02
text: Feels different from just seeing it in our\ntextbooks. It’s so intense...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_rival_01
text: Normally we’d never be able to get in here to\nsee it for ourselves![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_friend_01
text: It seems like it got spooked by something.\nIt’s hiding in its ball.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_botan_03
text: Can we even get back up to the surface\nwithout it?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_friend_02
text: Ah, should be all right. The last time I was here...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_friend_03
text: I caught a Flying Taxi out of the crater. They\nalways come through, if you’re a real sob story...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_botan_04
text: Why didn’t you just call the professor, if [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0001)]she’s\ndown here? Don’t get along or something?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_friend_04
text: Tch! None of your business, pipsqueak.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_botan_05
text: Geez, no need to bite my head off. What’re you\ngetting all huffy for anyway?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_rival_04
text: OK, come on, you two! This is an adventure!\nLet’s just have a good time![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
